back: On-Demand (no commitment), Savings Plans and Reserved Instances (1-3 years, up to ~72% off), Spot (up to 90% off, interruptible), Dedicated Hosts/Instances (dedicated hardware), and Capacity Reservations.

es.back: Bajo demanda (sin compromiso), Savings Plans y Reservadas (1-3 años, hasta ~72% desc.), Spot (hasta 90%, interrumpibles), Dedicated Hosts/Instances (hardware dedicado) y Capacity Reservations.

back: General purpose (M, T), compute (C), memory (R, X), accelerated/GPU (P, G, Trn, Inf), storage (I, D), and HPC (Hpc).

es.back: Propósito general (M, T), cómputo (C), memoria (R, X), acelerado/GPU (P, G, Trn, Inf), almacenamiento (I, D) y HPC (Hpc).

back: Amazon Machine Image: a template with the OS, software, and configuration used to launch instances.

es.back: Amazon Machine Image: plantilla con SO, software y configuración para lanzar instancias.

back: Event-driven serverless compute, billed by requests and GB-seconds, maximum 15 minutes per invocation.

es.back: Cómputo serverless por eventos, cobro por solicitudes y GB-segundo, máximo 15 minutos por invocación.

front: ECS vs EKS vs Fargate vs ECR
back: ECS: AWS container orchestrator. EKS: managed Kubernetes. Fargate: serverless compute for ECS/EKS. ECR: image registry.

es.front: ECS vs EKS vs Fargate vs ECR
es.back: ECS: orquestador de contenedores de AWS. EKS: Kubernetes administrado. Fargate: cómputo serverless para ECS/EKS. ECR: registro de imágenes.

back: Standard, Intelligent-Tiering, Standard-IA, One Zone-IA, Glacier Instant Retrieval, Glacier Flexible Retrieval, and Glacier Deep Archive (the cheapest).

es.back: Standard, Intelligent-Tiering, Standard-IA, One Zone-IA, Glacier Instant Retrieval, Glacier Flexible Retrieval y Glacier Deep Archive (la más barata).

back: Durability 99.999999999% (11 nines); designed availability 99.99%.

es.front: Durabilidad y disponibilidad de S3 Standard
es.back: Durabilidad 99.999999999% (11 nueves); disponibilidad de diseño 99.99%.

back: Block Public Access, versioning, MFA Delete, Object Lock (WORM), default encryption (SSE-S3), and bucket policies.

es.back: Block Public Access, versionado, MFA Delete, Object Lock (WORM), cifrado por defecto (SSE-S3) y políticas de bucket.

front: EBS vs EFS vs instance store
back: EBS: persistent block storage in one AZ. EFS: shared multi-AZ NFS file storage for Linux. Instance store: ephemeral high-performance local disk.

es.front: EBS vs EFS vs instance store
es.back: EBS: bloque persistente en una AZ. EFS: archivos NFS compartidos multi-AZ para Linux. Instance store: disco local efímero de alto rendimiento.

back: Managed file systems: FSx for Windows File Server (SMB), Lustre (HPC), NetApp ONTAP, and OpenZFS.

es.back: Sistemas de archivos administrados: FSx for Windows File Server (SMB), Lustre (HPC), NetApp ONTAP y OpenZFS.

back: A hybrid service that connects on-premises applications to AWS storage: File, Volume, and Tape Gateway.

es.back: Servicio híbrido que conecta aplicaciones locales con almacenamiento de AWS: File, Volume y Tape Gateway.

back: Amazon RDS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2) and Amazon Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL compatible, high performance).

es.front: Bases de datos relacionales en AWS
es.back: Amazon RDS (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2) y Amazon Aurora (compatible MySQL/PostgreSQL, alto rendimiento).

back: DynamoDB (key-value), DocumentDB (documents/MongoDB), Neptune (graph), Keyspaces (Cassandra), Timestream (time series), ElastiCache/MemoryDB (in-memory).

es.front: Bases de datos de propósito específico
es.back: DynamoDB (clave-valor), DocumentDB (documentos/MongoDB), Neptune (grafos), Keyspaces (Cassandra), Timestream (series temporales), ElastiCache/MemoryDB (en memoria).

back: Multi-AZ: high availability with automatic failover to a standby. Read replicas: scale reads (asynchronous).

es.front: RDS Multi-AZ vs réplicas de lectura
es.back: Multi-AZ: alta disponibilidad con failover automático a una standby. Réplicas de lectura: escalan lecturas (asíncronas).

back: A columnar data warehouse for petabyte-scale analytics (OLAP).

es.back: Data warehouse columnar para analítica (OLAP) a escala de petabytes.

back: Security group: instance level, stateful, allow rules only. NACL: subnet level, stateless, numbered allow and deny rules.

es.back: Security group: nivel instancia, stateful, sólo reglas de permitir. NACL: nivel subred, stateless, reglas de permitir y denegar numeradas.

back: Public: its route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 to an internet gateway. Private: no direct route to the IGW; reaches the internet through a NAT gateway.

es.back: Pública: su tabla de rutas envía 0.0.0.0/0 a un internet gateway. Privada: sin ruta directa al IGW; sale a Internet mediante NAT gateway.

back: Direct Connect: dedicated private physical connection (weeks to install, consistent). VPN: encrypted IPsec tunnel over the internet (minutes).

es.back: Direct Connect: conexión física dedicada y privada (semanas en instalar, consistente). VPN: túnel IPsec cifrado sobre Internet (minutos).

back: Peering: 1-to-1 connection between VPCs, not transitive. Transit Gateway: a central hub that connects many VPCs and on-premises networks.

es.back: Peering: conexión 1 a 1 entre VPC, no transitiva. Transit Gateway: hub central que conecta muchas VPC y redes locales.

front: CloudFront vs Route 53 vs Global Accelerator
back: CloudFront: CDN with caching. Route 53: DNS and routing (latency, failover, geolocation). Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs and the AWS network for TCP/UDP.

es.front: CloudFront vs Route 53 vs Global Accelerator
es.back: CloudFront: CDN con caché. Route 53: DNS y enrutamiento (latencia, failover, geolocalización). Global Accelerator: IPs anycast estáticas y red de AWS para TCP/UDP.
